import json, subprocess, sys, time
BASE = json.load(open("examples/input.json"))
s = json.dumps(BASE)
# exactly 16 MiB with trailing whitespace
pad = s + "\n" * (16*1024*1024 - len(s))
assert len(pad.encode()) == 16*1024*1024
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"],input=pad.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
exp = json.load(open("examples/expected.json"))
print("exact 16MiB valid:", json.loads(p.stdout)==exp, "%.2fs"%(time.time()-t0))
pad2 = s + "\n" * (16*1024*1024 - len(s) + 1)
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"],input=pad2.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print("16MiB+1:", p.stdout, "%.2fs"%(time.time()-t0))
# leading whitespace
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"submission/main.py"],input=(b"  \n\t"+s.encode()),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("leading ws ok:", json.loads(p.stdout)==exp)
EOF
